hero.name: Oscar Ayala
hero.title: Software Engineer
hero.tagline: Building enterprise web applications with Sencha Ext JS, JavaScript, and a focus on performance.

about: I design and build data-dense web applications used in regulated, real-world workflows — currently the pharmacy operations space. My day-to-day mixes JavaScript front-end engineering with the integration work that keeps a product trustworthy: REST APIs, configuration, security headers, and the small UX details that make a screen scannable instead of overwhelming.

I take performance seriously. Sencha apps can be enormous; mine stay quick because I treat every grid, panel, and theme decision as a budget item. I prefer plain solutions that hold up under scrutiny over clever ones that don't.
Outside of work I'm interested in clean typography, the craft side of software (testing discipline, code review), and learning how to teach what I know.

experience.summary: Frontend on PharmacyPortal — a Sencha Ext JS classic application for pharmacy operations.
bullets: Owned the approval, order release, HL7 log, and HOA modules end-to-end.
Authored the custom alixarx-classic-theme package layered on theme-crisp.
Hardened login flow and runtime config loading; reduced startup work.
Bullet one — what you owned, not what was on the team.
Bullet two — a measurable outcome where possible.
Bullet three — a technical detail that signals depth.

projects.name: PharmacyPortal
projects.blurb: Sencha Ext JS classic toolkit application for pharmacy operations — approvals, order release, HL7 error tracking, HOA management, and EMC config tooling. Custom theme, role-based login, runtime config.

projects.name: RESCITE

goals: Next 18 months: keep deepening on web performance, contribute to a public open-source project I rely on day-to-day, and grow into a role with more architectural ownership.
